decision.hypothesis: An independent device-balanced shallow branch trained on all retained rows captures low-score fault patterns missed by the frozen parent model; max fusion improves overall F1 by recovering missed hits while limiting new false alarms.
decision.expected: CV F1 gain over parent, with new hits exceeding lost hits and a controlled increase in false alarms.
decision.falsification: If CV F1 does not improve or paired bootstrap P(better) < 0.9, the parallel branch is not accepted.
